title: 2 men injured in late-night shooting in Dorchester, police say
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Two men were injured in a late-night shooting on Hancock St. in Dorchester around 10:40 p.m. Friday.
Both men, who have not been publicly identified, suffered non-life-threatening injuries and are expected to survive.
Boston police have not identified any suspects, and the investigation into the shooting is ongoing.

title: Woman trapped, injured in second incident on MBTA Davis escalator this year
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: A woman was injured Friday after her clothing got trapped in an MBTA Davis Station escalator.
A fellow rider used the emergency stop button and helped free the woman, who was hospitalized for a hand injury.
This incident is similar to a fatal accident at Davis earlier this year involving Steven McCluskey.

title: 2 men arrested after allegedly stealing chain, wallet at knifepoint in Dorchester
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Two men, Aguasvivas and Ramirez-Astacio, are charged with armed robbery and assault in Dorchester on Thursday.
The suspects allegedly robbed a woman at knifepoint on Humboldt Ave, taking her chain and wallet.
Aguasvivas was arrested at Tremont St, Ramirez-Astacio fled and was arrested later; both face multiple charges.

title: It’s not too late to submit your idea for $2 million in Boston spending
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston extends deadline for participatory budgeting project submissions from July 31 to August 7.
Residents can propose ideas for $2 million in funding, focusing on one-time investments within city authority.
Final proposal voting is set for January 15 through February 15 after community evaluation in fall.

title: Watch: Ceddanne Rafaela hits home runs in back-to-back at-bats
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela hit back-to-back home runs in his first two at-bats against the Dodgers on Saturday night.
Rafaela's first homer provided the Red Sox an early 1-0 lead with a 389-foot shot in the first inning.
Rafaela hit his second home run, 402 feet, tying the game at 2-2 in the third inning at Dodger Stadium.

title: Red Sox reportedly attempted to acquire shortstop Elly De La Cruz, turned down by Reds
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: The Boston Red Sox attempted to trade for Cincinnati Reds shortstop Elly De La Cruz but were turned down.
The Red Sox's offer was mainly prospect-based; they did not agree on the trade framework with the Reds.
Boston seeks to strengthen its shortstop position, with Curtis Mead injured and Trevor Story recovering.

title: Drake Maye says his shoulder ‘feels great’ as Patriots training camp continues
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Drake Maye confirms his throwing shoulder is fully recovered as Patriots training camp unfolds in Foxborough.
Maye received a pain-killing injection before Super Bowl LX, impacting his performance in a 29-13 loss to the Seahawks.
Wide receiver A.J. Brown joins the Patriots, strengthening offensive options after offseason roster changes.

title: If July’s stretch of dominance wasn’t enough, the Red Sox’ win Friday proved they’re plenty capable of a postseason run
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Boston Red Sox defeated the Los Angeles Dodgers 5-4 on Friday, continuing their strong performance in recent games.
Ceddanne Rafaela's pivotal play turned the game around, while Andruw Monasterio contributed a 2-RBI double.
Despite key player absences, Boston remains competitive and could be buyers before the upcoming trade deadline.

title: Red Sox fend off Dodgers, 9-4, in grindy series opener
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela hit a go-ahead two-run homer in the seventh, leading Red Sox to a 9-4 win over Dodgers.
Brayan Bello pitched four scoreless innings in relief, helping Boston secure their 21st win in July.
Red Sox finished July with a franchise-best 21-4 record, improving their playoff chances in 2026.

title: Gabe Jacas makes his Patriots debut and other takeaways from Day 7 of training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Gabe Jacas, Patriots' 2026 second-round pick, made his practice debut in a limited role after a knee procedure.
The Patriots' defense recorded two interceptions during Day 7 of training camp, disrupting Drake Maye's offensive efforts.
Undrafted rookie Tanner Arkin impressed as a strong blocker, gaining regular reps with the Patriots' first-team unit.
